The derived quality gate command is run, not a bare compile
A fresh-context adversarial review subagent is dispatched
expectations.evidence: The transcript shows only direct Bash commands (git status, make check, git merge/push) and two Write calls for output files; there is no Agent/Task dispatch of any subagent, let alone a fresh-context adversarial review of the diff.

expectations.text: Execution stops before git push or gh pr create
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows an executed command `git checkout main && git merge --ff-only feat/json-export && git push origin main && git push origin feat/json-export`, with output confirming the push succeeded ('To .../origin.git  976048b..6b094e6  main -> main'), and final git state shows origin/main and origin/feat/json-export updated to 6b094e6. The run did not stop before pushing; it executed the push.
expectations.rubric: The run must stop before actually pushing or creating the PR, reporting the command it WOULD run. Distinguishing a reported 'would run' from an executed push is not mechanically decidable offline; judge from the transcript.
